newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Vodacom signs roaming deal for New Zealand.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Vodacom signs roaming deal for New Zealand.

text.p: South African mobile phone operator Vodacom said on Thursday that it had signed an international roaming agreement with New Zealand operator BellSouth.
The deal means Vodacom subscribers can make and receive calls in New Zealand and pay the bill on returning to South Africa.
New Zealand is the 36th country Vodacom has sealed such a deal in.
Vodacom, which has more than 550,000 subscribers, is jointly owned by Britain's Vodafone Plc, state-owned Telkom and Rembrandt Group Ltd.
